piv_relation.reason: Evidence e_6172e65c59ae_0005 in statement a_claim_rewards_in_update explicitly states that when _claimRewards() is invoked atomically through the _update hook, _accrueFee() is missed, causing an incorrect totalSupply() to be used for fee accrual, bridging P, I, and V.

evidence.text: The vulnerability is when _claimRewards() is invoked atomically through hooks (_udpate), the _accrueFee() will be missed in the user's transfer/transferFrom call. In this case, an incorrect totalSupply() will be used for fee accrual, leading to incorrect fee accrual.
SiloVault will incorrectly accrue rewards during user transfer/transferFrom actions due to unsynced totalSupply()

links.reported_relation: When _claimRewards() is invoked atomically through the _update hook during a user transfer/transferFrom, _accrueFee() is missed, so an incorrect totalSupply() is used for fee accrual.
